nativeEffectiveRoleRules.reasonForExplicitDenies: Native create compiles unlisted current UI/actions from enabled old defaults even when new default_access=0. Final plan enumerates all current User/Admin permissions and verifies effective rules after create/update.

nativeHostScope.limitation: Temporarily enabled the role API flag only in disposable fixtures to inspect native host.get permission filters; reset to API-deny immediately after each request. Actual UI host-configuration deny/allow and public API deny tested separately.

certificateExpiry.nativeToolkit: verified: pinned expired certificate with the same signing key still validates signatures; no automatic NotAfter enforcement
certificateExpiry.requiredOperation: Entra certificate-expiry notifications, owner rotation/requalification before NotAfter; do not claim native expiry rejection

exactVersionBehavior.strictMode: true; canonical baseurl; no proxy-header trust
exactVersionBehavior.destinationComparison: Keep toolkit default query-tolerant destination comparison for native ?acs. destinationStrictlyMatches=true rejected valid ACS in local test; strict=false is not used. Wrong-host destination is rejected.
exactVersionBehavior.requestCorrelation: Native processResponse() is called without a request ID; additional unsolicited-InResponseTo rejection would reject normal SP responses. Defaults retained; no stronger request-ID/replay enforcement claimed.
exactVersionBehavior.roleCreation: Every current native UI/action explicitly enumerated to prevent enabled creation-default inheritance. Effective role.create/update compared against plan in native 8.0.0.
exactVersionBehavior.jitRemoval: Groups/role updated only at a fresh assertion; no immediate Entra change notification, SCIM, Graph lookup or automatic session revocation
exactVersionBehavior.sessionRevocation: Native logout/old-cookie rejection and deprovisioning/old-cookie rejection verified. Immediate targeted native administrator revocation without a fresh assertion is not established; owner must qualify Access session revocation and emergency containment.
exactVersionBehavior.certificateTrust: Wrong pinned signing certificate/signature rejected; native toolkit does not enforce NotAfter on a pinned signing key; owner rotation/expiry notifications required
